utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting at the library on Thursday, or did that change?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re still on for Thursday at the library, as far as I know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — if the book club needs any tools or a hand setting up, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’s really kind of you, Gus — I might take you up on that if we end up needing help. I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — just give me a shout if you need anything for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club is meeting again soon—everyone’s been talking about what to read next!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d love to join, but I’m a bit worried about the timing—do we know where and when it’s meeting?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m not totally sure yet, but I can ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help with the book club—what are you thinking for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam. I’m thinking we meet at the library on Maple Street and keep it to about an hour.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds perfect to me—Maple Street library and an hour is easy to manage. Want me to help pick the book or send out a note to everyone?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club? I’d love to spread the word — when’s the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet, Quinn — I’m still waiting to confirm the date. I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — just send me the date when it’s set, and I’ll let folks know!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m glad you brought up the book club. What were you thinking for our next read?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I was thinking we could do something short and engaging this month—maybe a mystery or a lighter novel. If you want, I can suggest a few options.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Leo — I’d love a few options. A short mystery would be perfect for the group.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — what details should I check before I say yes?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Just the time and place, and whether there’s a theme for this month’s pick.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll check the time, place, and whether there’s a theme this month.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make the book club work around school pickup if we keep it to a bit after 3:30. What day were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That should work for me — how about Thursday around 3:45?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday at 3:45 works for me. I’ll be there after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a little behind on the book club chatter—what did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Just the usual book club buzz so far—no big spoilers yet. I can catch you up on the latest picks if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes please — I’d love the quick rundown on the latest picks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I skimmed the invite—when’s book club again?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m pretty sure it’s Thursday night, but let me confirm before we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just text me when you’ve confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still getting a feel for the book club. What book are you all reading next?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think we’re picking the next one at the meeting, but I can’t quite remember the title. I’d ask Mara; she usually knows before I do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Ah, got it — I’ll ask Mara at the meeting then. Thanks, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for book club this week—just let me know the time and place, and I’ll bring something to share.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Vik — we’re meeting Thursday at 7 in the community room, and snacks would be perfect if you can bring them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — Thursday at 7 in the community room, and I’ll bring snacks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club might meet at the cafe this week—have you heard the final time yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the final time yet, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey—that’d be great. I’ll keep an eye out for the update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I knew I was forgetting something. What book are we talking about again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re talking about the book club read for this month — I think it’s the mystery one we picked last week. I can check the title and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great, thanks — my memory’s a sieve lately. I’m pretty sure I’ll recognize it once you say the title.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—book club, right. What were we reading this week again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re on "The Midnight Library" this week. I can bring my copy if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — that’d help a lot. I’ll probably forget otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand if the book club needs anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll keep it simple and let you know what we need for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — just let me know and I’ll bring whatever I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — when’s the next book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll send the invite as soon as I have the date—I'm checking with everyone now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. Let me know when you’ve got the date.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad the book club’s bringing folks together—what are you all reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re reading "The Station House Letters" this week — I can bring the copy if you want.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, thanks! I’d love to borrow it and see what everyone’s chatting about.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Cleo — I’d be happy to help with the book club. What are you thinking for our first read?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, wonderful — I was thinking we could start with a short, cozy novel, something everyone can finish without too much fuss. Do you have a favorite in mind?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I do — I’d suggest something warm and easy to slip into, like "The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society." If you’d like, I can also think of a few shorter options for us to choose from.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve heard the book club’s been pretty lively lately — what are they reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re reading a mystery novel this month. Have you read it yet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not yet — I’ve only heard bits and pieces about it. Is it a good one?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what book are we on?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’re on "The Night Circus" this month — I’ll text the meeting details once I confirm the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — text me when you know the time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be glad to help with the book club—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm you’re actually free to help this week?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes—I’m free this week and happy to help.
